}}'''Nevarin''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Codarra]] [[Aiel]].

==Appearance==
She has green eyes and is quite young. She is very skinny with long sandy hair. Her temper and conduct has Perrin think of [[Nynaeve al'Meara|Nynaeve]].

==Strength and Abilities==
Nevarin can [[channel]] not very strongly but still with considerable strength. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|29}}, which is a middle-high ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength is just a level below the minimum needed to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

==Activities==
She is among the six Wise Ones that [[Traveling|Travel]] to [[Ghealdan]] with [[Perrin Aybara]] to keep an eye out on [[Seonid Traighan]] and [[Masuri Sokawa]].

After the [[Battle of Malden]], Perrin's army travels back through Ghealdan when they come across an area of land which is diseased. Perrin orders Navarin and the rest of the Wise Ones to burn it. She attends a meeting with Perrin to decide where the army should go. A decision is made for the Wise Ones and [[Asha'man]] to [[link]] to create a gateway into [[Cairhien]], where they will start looking for [[Rand al'Thor]].

In the making of ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' by Perrin he is helped with the [[One Power]] provided by [[Neald]], [[Grady]] and all six the Wise Ones in his camp.

Later it can be assumed that she stays along [[Edarra]] with Perrin's forces in the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]] and then she fights in their campaigns.
